retrieval: one isolated stored candidate per family; pinned MiniLM similarity; no candidate substitution
acceptance_rule: The experimental variant checks the reverse answer assertion only after current ACCEPT. A reverse score below the unchanged accept_at threshold downgrades ACCEPT to VERIFY; a reverse error or overlong input also VERIFY.
decision_rule: Keep the default only if valid reuse is retained and incorrect/ambiguous acceptance improves without an unacceptable latency or memory increase. No test-set retuning.
